resources.string: This page is connected to the shared Office 365 / Windows 11 Fluent navigation system. Its real feature workflow will be added in the upcoming development steps.
Use the bottom navigation to open every main section.
Caller identity, calling and safety in one place
The Home page will show caller lookup, protection status, quick actions, recent calls and important alerts.
Incoming, outgoing, missed and blocked calls
The Calls page will provide search, filters, SIM information, call direction, duration, caller status and quick actions.
Search, enter a number and choose a SIM
The Dial page will include number formatting, contact suggestions, spam warnings, dual-SIM calling and quick contact actions.
Favorites, family, work and business contacts
The Contacts page will show phone contacts with search, categories, availability labels and call or message shortcuts.
Warnings, blocking rules and community reports
The Protection page will manage spam detection, blocked numbers, unknown caller warnings, reports and safety preferences.
